# Base UI for Solid

@unstyled-solid/base-ui 0.0.2 (alpha). Requires Solid 2.0.0-rc.13.
An independent port of Base UI; upstream React integrations do not establish Solid compatibility.
Support and contributions: https://github.com/unstyled-solid/base-ui

Full documentation, including examples and API references: /llms-full.txt

- [Accordion](/solid/components/accordion.md): A set of collapsible panels with headings.
- [Alert Dialog](/solid/components/alert-dialog.md): A dialog that requires a user response to proceed.
- [Autocomplete](/solid/components/autocomplete.md): An input that suggests options as you type.
- [Avatar](/solid/components/avatar.md): An easily stylable avatar component.
- [Button](/solid/components/button.md): A button component that can be rendered as another tag or focusable when disabled.
- [Checkbox](/solid/components/checkbox.md): An easily stylable checkbox component.
- [Checkbox Group](/solid/components/checkbox-group.md): Provides shared state to a series of checkboxes.
- [Collapsible](/solid/components/collapsible.md): A collapsible panel controlled by a button.
- [Combobox](/solid/components/combobox.md): An input combined with a list of predefined items to select.
- [Context Menu](/solid/components/context-menu.md): A menu that appears at the pointer on right click or long press.
- [Dialog](/solid/components/dialog.md): A popup that opens on top of the entire page.
- [Drawer](/solid/components/drawer.md): A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.
- [Field](/solid/components/field.md): A component that provides labeling and validation for form controls.
- [Fieldset](/solid/components/fieldset.md): A native fieldset element with an easily stylable legend.
- [Form](/solid/components/form.md): A native form element with consolidated error handling.
- [Input](/solid/components/input.md): A native input element that automatically works with Field.
- [Menu](/solid/components/menu.md): A list of actions in a dropdown, enhanced with keyboard navigation.
- [Menubar](/solid/components/menubar.md): A menu bar providing commands and options for your application.
- [Meter](/solid/components/meter.md): A graphical display of a numeric value within a range.
- [Navigation Menu](/solid/components/navigation-menu.md): A collection of links and menus for website navigation.
- [Number Field](/solid/components/number-field.md): A numeric input element with increment and decrement buttons, and a scrub area.
- [OTP Field](/solid/components/otp-field.md): A one-time password input composed of individual character slots.
- [Components](/solid/components.md): Explore the components documentation for Base UI for Solid.
- [Popover](/solid/components/popover.md): An accessible popup anchored to a button.
- [Preview Card](/solid/components/preview-card.md): A link that shows a destination preview without interrupting keyboard or screen reader navigation.
- [Progress](/solid/components/progress.md): Displays the status of a task that takes a long time.
- [Radio Group](/solid/components/radio-group.md): Provides shared state to a series of radio buttons.
- [Scroll Area](/solid/components/scroll-area.md): A native scroll container with custom scrollbars.
- [Select](/solid/components/select.md): A common form component for choosing a predefined value in a dropdown menu.
- [Separator](/solid/components/separator.md): A separator element accessible to screen readers.
- [Slider](/solid/components/slider.md): An easily stylable range input.
- [Switch](/solid/components/switch.md): A control that indicates whether a setting is on or off.
- [Tabs](/solid/components/tabs.md): A component for toggling between related panels on the same page.
- [Toast](/solid/components/toast.md): Generates toast notifications.
- [Toggle](/solid/components/toggle.md): A two-state button that can be on or off.
- [Toggle Group](/solid/components/toggle-group.md): Provides a shared state to a series of toggle buttons.
- [Toolbar](/solid/components/toolbar.md): A container for grouping a set of buttons and controls.
- [Tooltip](/solid/components/tooltip.md): A popup that appears when an element is hovered or focused, showing a hint for sighted users.
- [Animation](/solid/handbook/animation.md): A guide to animating Base UI components.
- [Composition](/solid/handbook/composition.md): A guide to composing Base UI components with your own Solid components.
- [Customization](/solid/handbook/customization.md): A guide to customizing the behavior of Base UI components.
- [Forms](/solid/handbook/forms.md): A guide to building forms with Base UI components.
- [Handbook](/solid/handbook.md): Explore the handbook documentation for Base UI for Solid.
- [Styling](/solid/handbook/styling.md): A guide to styling Base UI components with your preferred styling engine.
- [TypeScript](/solid/handbook/typescript.md): A guide to using TypeScript with Base UI.
- [About Base UI for Solid](/solid/overview/about.md): A Solid 2 port of the open-source Base UI component library for building accessible user interfaces.
- [Accessibility](/solid/overview/accessibility.md): Learn how to make the most of Base UI's accessibility features and guidelines.
- [Community](/solid/overview/community.md): The Base UI ecosystem, support channels, and ways to stay up to date.
- [Overview](/solid/overview.md): Explore the overview documentation for Base UI for Solid.
- [Quick start](/solid/overview/quick-start.md): A quick guide to getting started with Base UI.
- [Documentation](/solid.md): Guides, components, and utilities for Base UI for Solid.
- [CSP Provider](/solid/utils/csp-provider.md): Configures CSP-related behavior for inline tags rendered by Base UI components.
- [Direction Provider](/solid/utils/direction-provider.md): Enables RTL behavior for Base UI components.
- [mergeProps](/solid/utils/merge-props.md): A utility to merge multiple sets of Solid props.
- [Utils](/solid/utils.md): Explore the utils documentation for Base UI for Solid.
- [useRender](/solid/utils/use-render.md): Utility for enabling a render prop in custom components.
- [Base UI for Solid releases](/solid/overview/releases.md): An independent, unofficial Solid 2 port of Base UI. Alpha release 0.0.2.
- [0.0.1 — Alpha](/solid/overview/releases/v0-0-1.md): An independent, unofficial Solid 2 port of Base UI. Alpha release 0.0.2.
